bases.collateral: margin 0.5 × notional in USDT; cash and spot earn zero; no cross-margin netting — an unfavourable channel
bases.execution_price: the same close plus taker fees (spot 10 bps, perpetual 5 bps); no spread, no slippage, no market impact — a favourable channel, covered only by the declared haircut
bases.funding_notional: position size × that close; the venue settles on mark-price notional (WO-166 A8 bound: ≤ 1 × 10⁻⁵ of notional per period, direction indeterminate)
bases.haircut: 2.0 pp per year, a declared assumption; it is not a measured bound on venue, stablecoin-depeg or liquidation risk and this WO measures none of them
bases.liquidation_check: kline high of the last traded price against the period-start margin ratio; the venue liquidates on the mark price, which is smoothed, so the last-price high triggers at least as often — a conservative channel
bases.mark_price: Binance 1h kline close of the hour ending at the boundary (last traded price), not the venue mark price
